verdict.rationale: BVNK documents programmatic crypto/fiat wallet creation via API, including wallets created for specific customers (bvnk-docs-4, bvnk-docs-25). A probe found an official agent-wallet-cli repo (bvnk-probe-2), which hints at first-party agent wallet tooling, but the evidence describes none of its contents. API access uses Hawk key authentication, but nothing shows the keys can be scoped per agent or permission. Missing for 10: scoped or per-agent API keys, agent spending policy controls, documented limits on what an agent can move, any detail on what agent-wallet-cli does, and independent corroboration.
